note: BH-8186: the longest hold of a same-patch head whose failed batch no solo re-run judged (pending, could-not-run or none). Past it the record is cleared once (cleared:window) and the head may be enqueued. A solo re-run that reproduces the failure parks the head for the resolver whatever this says. Default 86400 s = the ticket's one day. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_failed_batch_unjudged_hold_s. 0 turns the hold off: no hold without a verdict.
